subject: POC/trial planning - success criteria & RACI - Sunrise Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC/trial planning - success criteria & RACI

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. As promised, here is a concise recap of what we discussed and proposed next steps for the 2-week POC trial. Please review and confirm owners/timing so we can lock the kickoff.

1) Success criteria (what will make the POC a success)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms on representative inference routes (chat generation)
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions with <10% queuing
- Quality: sample prompt set scoring at or above your expected baseline (we'll use your 200 prompt test corpus)
- Cost target: average inference cost under your internal threshold (we'll review token estimates post-run)

2) Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): infra provisioning, dataset ingest, and access controls
- Week 1 (run): run production-like traffic profiles, capture metrics (latency, errors, token usage)
- Week 2 (analysis): review logs, qualitative review of outputs, and decision meeting

3) Timeline
- Confirm kickoff: proposed Tue, Aug 3 at 09:00 PT
- Prep window: Aug 3-7
- Trial run: Aug 10-21
- Decision: Aug 24

4) Ownership / RACI (initial mapping)
- Infra (VPC, cluster, networking): R = Aditya Rao (internal). A = Sunrise Health infra lead (Tom for now). C = Lauren Bishop (CSM). I = Marissa Cole.
- App / Integration (embedding ingestion, request routing): R = Sunrise app owner (Samantha). C = Aditya Rao. I = Lauren / Marissa.
- Security & Compliance (SOC2 evidence, access control, logging): R = Sunrise security lead (please confirm). C = Aditya Rao, Lauren. I = Marissa.
- Procurement / Legal (PO, contract signature): R = Sunrise procurement (procurement@sunrisehealth.com). C = Marissa.

5) Next steps (actionable)
- Samantha / Tom: confirm procurement and security point of contact (due by Tue, Jul 28)
- Marissa: share POC runbook and mutual action plan (attached)
- Aditya: start infra checklist and provide expected ports/IPs for allowlist
- Lauren: schedule kickoff invite for Aug 3 and produce meeting agenda

Attachments included: sunrise_poc_runbook.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

If this looks good I will send a calendar invite and loop in procurement/security contacts.

Thanks,
Marissa
